HeishaMon

History

Loading…
Charts are read from persistent SD-card CSV history. Select a period of up to 90 days; the display is downsampled without averaging COP values.

Temperatures

All values are in °C. The colored legend identifies every line.

Zone 1 request

Only the semantic series matching each sample is drawn. Heating curve shift (K), heating water target (°C) and room target (°C) are never merged into one line.

Compressor / hydraulics

The series use their native units: Hz, l/min and kW.

Efficiency / COP

Estimated COP is calculated from thermal and electrical source values. Aggregated ranges use energy totals, not averaged COP samples.

DHW

Storage settings

Loading…
Storage interval

How often a history sample is stored in RAM and on the SD card.

SD retention

Automatically removes old history and event CSV files. Unlimited uses the available SD-card space.

Electrical power source

Used for the estimated COP. Keep Panasonic selected unless an external MQTT power meter has been configured.
